questions.stem:
—I ______ the Summer Palace last weekend. It was amazing!
—Really? I ______ there three times.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查现在完成时和一般过去时的区别。第一空后有明确的时间状语"last weekend"（上周末），表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，用一般过去时visited；第二空表示"曾经去过某地三次"，强调对现在的影响或经历，用现在完成时have been。B选项时态颠倒；C选项第二空缺少完成时态；D选项第一空不能用完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The students ______ won the English speech contest are from Class 3.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查定语从句的关系代词。先行词是"students"（学生），指人，且在从句中作主语，所以用who。which指物；whom指人但只能作宾语；whose表示"……的"，作定语。从句中缺少主语，因此选A。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The old library ______ last year to make room for a new science building.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查被动语态。主语"library"（图书馆）和"pull down"（拆除）之间是被动关系，需要用被动语态be+过去分词。时间状语"last year"表明是一般过去时，因此用was pulled down。A是主动语态；B是一般现在时的被动，时态不符；D是现在完成时的主动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Why don't you go to the concert with us tonight?
—Because I ______ the band twice. I'm not interested anymore.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查现在完成时的用法。答句强调"已经看过两次"这一经历对现在的影响（不想去），用现在完成时have seen。A选项一般过去时只表示过去发生的动作，与现在无关；C选项一般现在时不符；D选项过去完成时需要参照过去某一时间点，此处没有。解题技巧：遇到"twice/never/ever/before"等表示经历次数的词，优先考虑现在完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the classroom to save energy.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查动词短语辨析。turn on打开；turn off关闭；turn up调高（音量）；turn down调低（音量）。根据语境"leave the classroom"（离开教室）和"save energy"（节约能源），应该是关灯，所以选B。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The ______ news made all of us feel ______.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查-ing和-ed形容词的用法。exciting（令人兴奋的）修饰事物，excited（感到兴奋的）修饰人。第一空修饰news（消息），用exciting；第二空修饰us（我们），用excited。口诀：-ing形容物，-ed形容人。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It's important for us to ______ a good habit of reading before going to bed.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查固定搭配。develop a habit养成习惯，是固定搭配。make制作；do做；take带走。表示"养成习惯"只能用develop，表示逐步培养形成。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage: Many students in our school care about environmental protection. Last month, our class started a recycling project. We collected plastic bottles and old books from every classroom. At first, some students thought it was (8)______ to carry so many heavy bags to the collection room. But soon they realized how important this work was. The bottles (9)______ to a factory and were made into new products like pencil boxes. Our teacher, Mr. Wang, was very proud (10)______ us. He said, "Small actions can make a big (11)______." Now more students want to join us. We plan to (12)______ this project next term and collect more recyclable materials to help protect our planet.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查语境推理。根据后文"heavy bags"（沉重的袋子）和"But soon they realized..."（但很快他们意识到……）的转折关系，可推断起初学生觉得搬运这些袋子很"困难"，所以选B。A（容易的）和D（放松的）与heavy bags矛盾；C（有趣的）没有体现后文的转折逻辑。

questions.explanation: 这道题考查固定搭配和语境理解。make a big difference产生重大影响/有很大不同，是固定搭配。A（错误）、B（决定）、D（进步）都不能与make构成此含义的搭配。老师想表达"小行动能带来大改变"，所以选C。

questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel tired in class? Many students don't get enough sleep because they use smartphones before bed. Scientists have found that the blue light from screens affects our sleep quality.

A recent study shows that teenagers need at least 8 hours of sleep every night. However, about 60% of middle school students sleep less than 7 hours. This can cause problems with memory and concentration.

Dr. Li, a sleep expert, suggests some useful tips. First, turn off all electronic devices an hour before bedtime. Second, keep your bedroom cool and dark. Third, try to go to bed at the same time every night. "Good sleep habits are as important as good study habits," says Dr. Li.

Some schools have changed their morning schedules to let students start classes later. Early results show that students feel more energetic and get better grades when they get enough rest.
questions.stem: According to the passage, how many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night?
questions.explanation: 这道题考查细节理解。根据文章第二段第一句"A recent study shows that teenagers need at least 8 hours of sleep every night"（最新研究表明青少年每晚至少需要8小时睡眠），直接找到答案C。A和B是干扰项（文中提到60%学生睡不到7小时，但这不是需要的时长）；D文中未提及。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

questions.stem: What does the underlined word "concentration" in Paragraph 2 probably mean?
questions.explanation: 这道题考查词义猜测。根据上下文"This can cause problems with memory and concentration"（这会导致记忆力和concentration方面的问题），and连接并列成分，memory是"记忆力"，与之并列且与睡眠不足有关的应该是"注意力"。睡眠不足会导致上课注意力不集中。A选项是memory的意思；C（创造力）和D（想象力）与睡眠缺乏的直接关联较小。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the last paragraph?
options: A. All schools will start classes later.
B. Students hate the new schedule.
C. Changing schedules is bad for grades.
D. More sleep may help students study better.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查推理判断。最后一段提到"Early results show that students feel more energetic and get better grades when they get enough rest"（早期结果显示，当学生得到充足休息时，他们感到更有活力且成绩更好），可推断出充足的睡眠有助于学习，D正确。A（所有学校都将推迟上课时间）过于绝对，文中只说some schools；B（学生讨厌新时间表）与文意相反；C（改变时间表对成绩有害）与文中"get better grades"矛盾。

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?
options: A. How to Use Smartphones Properly
B. The Importance of Sleep for Teenagers
D. Ways to Get Better Grades
questions.explanation: 这道题考查主旨大意。文章围绕青少年睡眠不足的问题展开，分析了原因（使用手机）、危害（影响记忆力和注意力）、建议（专家三条建议）以及学校的应对措施，核心是睡眠对青少年的重要性。A（如何正确使用手机）只是文中提到的一个细节；C（学校时间表变化）是最后一段的内容；D（提高成绩的方法）过于宽泛。B选项最全面概括文章主旨。

questions.group_passage:
Starting middle school can be exciting but also challenging. Here are some useful tips to help you adapt to the new environment.

(17)______ Get a planner and write down your homework and important dates. This will help you manage your time better and never miss deadlines.

(18)______ Don't be afraid to ask teachers or classmates when you don't understand something. Everyone needs help sometimes, and it's a great way to learn.

(19)______ Join clubs or sports teams to meet people who share your interests. Having good friends makes school life more enjoyable and less stressful.

(20)______ Remember to exercise regularly and get enough sleep. A healthy body is the foundation of good academic performance.
options: A. However, try not to join too many clubs.
B. First, make sure to stay organized.
C. In addition, don't hesitate to ask for help.
D. Finally, keep a balance between study and rest.
E. Also, try to make new friends.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查段落衔接。后文提到"Get a planner... write down homework"（用计划本记录作业），这些都是关于保持条理、做好组织安排的建议，与B选项"First, make sure to stay organized"（首先，确保保持条理）对应。First也表明这是第一条建议，符合文章"Here are some useful tips"的总起。
